description: TY2025: the Form 8812 ordering — education credits reduce tax BEFORE the CTC limit, pushing displaced CTC into the refundable ACTC. MFJ, $36,000 wages + $12,000 interest (kills EITC: investment income over the $11,950 limit), 2 kids, $4,000 AOTC. TI = 16,500 -> Table midpoint 16,525 -> 10% -> 1,653. Education nonrefundable = min(1,500, 1,653) = 1,500 -> CTC limit = 153 -> CTC 153; unused 4,400-153 = 4,247 -> ACTC = min(4,247, 2x1,700, 15%x33,500) = 3,400. Refundable = ACTC 3,400 + AOTC 1,000. Net = 0 - 4,400 = -$4,400.00 refund.
